name: Shared model projection
responsibility: Projects canonical module scopes into shared renderer content
description: One shared projection selects recursive scopes, focus, and visual filters without copying architecture. It groups connections by visible endpoints, kind, and comparison standing. A line ends on the part that owns it, and only a relationship that names the open module stays on its frame. A module outside the open one that a line reaches stands as a door, and doorEndpoints names what stands behind it. Every relationship has a line unless a filter hides its kind or it joins an open module to a part that it holds. Aggregate lines summarize their hidden relationships while the right panel retains every original identity and label. Complete authored flows remain ordered and unchanged.
